rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something increases in size or extent, or when someone makes it larger.

example.english: The company plans to extend the scope of its services.
example.traditional: 公司打算擴大服務範圍。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 daa2 syun3 kwok3 daai6 fuk6 mou6 faan6 wai4

rows.note: Use this when making an event, period, deadline, or other duration last longer.

example.english: We can extend the contract for another year.
example.traditional: 份合約可以延長多一年。
example.jyutping: fan6 hap6 joek3 ho2 ji5 jin4 coeng4 do1 jat1 nin4

rows.note: Use this for something physically running or spreading across a distance or area.

example.english: The tunnel seems to extend to the foot of the mountain.
example.jyutping: tiu4 seoi6 dou6 san1 jin4 dou3 saan1 gok3

rows.note: Use this for the sympathy slice of “extend,” especially when expressing sympathy to someone suffering.

example.english: We want to extend our sympathy to the affected families.
example.traditional: 我哋向受影響嘅家庭表示同情。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hoeng3 sau6 jing2 hoeng2 ge3 gaa1 ting4 biu2 si6 tung4 cing4
